_meta.role: Legal Truth Store — the single place statutory content lives (Act -> Section)
_meta.population_status: SKELETON - no acts or provisions populated yet
governance: CLAUDE.md Section 7.2 (three-file structure), 7.4 (record format), 7.5 (human-only verification), 7.6 (legal source rules)

Modified by human curation only. Legal text enters this file only from an approved official source (India Code, or an official central-government ministry / regulator / statutory-authority publication).
No AI assistant may set verification.status = 'manually_verified' or provision_status = 'in_force' as a final verified fact. Every new provision starts at the defaults below.
Citizen-facing eligibility (Phase 1) requires BOTH verification.status == 'manually_verified' AND provision_status == 'in_force'. Neither field alone is sufficient.
If a source URL is unconfirmed, official_source_url must be null - never a placeholder URL.
consumed_by: Module 3 (Legal Intelligence Engine): resolves act_id + section_id references from issue_mappings.json against this file, then applies the eligibility check before anything is returned.
knowledge_base_loader: loads and reference-validates this file at ML-service startup (read-only at runtime).

<act_id>._id_rule: act_id is a stable snake_case string, e.g. 'it_act_2000'. Referenced by ID everywhere; never duplicated as free text.
<act_id>.official_act_name: string - official name as published on the official source, e.g. 'Information Technology Act, 2000'
<act_id>.short_name: string - display short form, e.g. 'IT Act 2000'
<act_id>.official_source_url: string | null - confirmed URL only; null until a human confirms it

<section_id>._id_rule: section_id is a stable lowercase string, e.g. '66d'. The pair (act_id, section_id) is the provision reference used by issue_mappings.json.
<section_id>.section_number: string - official section number as displayed, e.g. '66D'
<section_id>.official_section_title: string | null - official title; null until sourced from the approved official source
<section_id>.official_text: string | null - official statutory text; populated ONLY from an approved official source, never from AI memory. Never shown raw in the default citizen response.
<section_id>.simplified_explanation: string | null - plain-language explanation for citizens. May be AI-drafted but is human-reviewed; must follow CLAUDE.md Section 10 wording rules (no 'definitely applies', no legal-certainty claims).
<section_id>.applicability_notes: string | null - conditions/context for when this provision may be relevant
<section_id>.keywords: array of strings - supporting/debugging signals only (may feed scenario_signals display). NEVER a primary decision mechanism (CLAUDE.md Section 6.6). May be empty.
<section_id>.citation: string | null - formal human-readable citation, e.g. 'Section 66D, Information Technology Act, 2000'. Display/audit aid only; never a substitute for official_source_name/official_source_url.
<section_id>.provision_status: enum: 'unverified' (DEFAULT for every new candidate) | 'in_force' | 'omitted' | 'repealed' | 'amended_review_required' | 'applicability_uncertain'. Human-governed; only 'in_force' is citizen-facing eligible in Phase 1, and only together with manual verification.

verification.status: enum: 'pending_manual_verification' (DEFAULT) | 'manually_verified'. Human-only transition; set only after a human checks the provision against an approved official source under CLAUDE.md Section 7.6.
verification.verified_by: string | null - human verifier's name; null until verified
verification.verified_on: string | null - date 'YYYY-MM-DD'; null until verified
